name: films12-names
description: The names of the films beyond the first seven in all 34 menu languages, and Portra renamed to Portra 400 (Grainy Film -> Provia, Gentle Sepia -> Ektar 100, Dramatic Tone -> Portra 160, Key Line -> Gold 200, Watercolor -> Vis 500T, Portra -> Portra 400; string ids 62, 63, 64, 67, 583, 597, 601, 650, 1163, 1194, 1452, 1453, 1717, 1718; in chs, kor some ids that show the same text share one string, which gives the room). The spec also holds what data/specs/film-names-all-languages.json does (the names of the first seven films in all languages) and takes its place in a build: put it after the other specs of the pinned build, and leave film-names-all-languages out. One spec, because `epm2mod make` lets no later spec change a byte that an earlier spec covers and keeps, and the Japanese names need such bytes. A name longer than its old string is moved inside the language's text pool and the pointer of its id is changed. Made by experiments/2026-11-16-films-max/scripts/names_spec.py.
